concept.title: Configuring Red Hat Single Sign-On for Red Hat Quay
concept.shortdesc: You can configure Red Hat Single Sign-On (RH-SSO) as an OpenID Connect provider for Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform. Create an RH-SSO client, then add an RHSSO_LOGIN_CONFIG block to your Operator config bundle.

conbody.p: Based on the Keycloak project, Red Hat Single Sign-On (RH-SSO) is an open source identity and access management (IAM) solution provided by Red Hat. RH-SSO allows organizations to manage user identities, secure applications, and enforce access control policies across their systems and applications. It also provides a unified authentication and authorization framework, which allows users to log in one time and gain access to multiple applications and resources without needing to re-authenticate.
By configuring Red Hat Single Sign-On on Red Hat Quay, you can create a seamless authentication integration between Red Hat Quay and other application platforms like OpenShift Container Platform.
